master_scenes.speaker: alex
master_scenes.text: AI agents can plan trips, compare prices, and negotiate deals in seconds. Until today, the moment it was time to actually pay, everything stopped.
master_scenes.caption: AI agents negotiate deals in seconds, until checkout stops them cold.

master_scenes.speaker: maya
master_scenes.text: Because nobody wants a bot touching their raw credit card. That changes with PayPal Linked Wallets for agents, and today we are launching PayTable.
master_scenes.caption: Launching PayTable: collaborative PayPal Linked Wallets for AI agents.

master_scenes.speaker: alex
master_scenes.text: Here is how you use PayTable in four clear steps. First, pick an everyday preset or type an at paytable prompt on the shared tabletop.
master_scenes.caption: Step 1: Pick any everyday preset or prompt @paytable on the shared tabletop.

master_scenes.speaker: maya
master_scenes.text: Second, watch Pip search live catalogs, compare three merchant quotes, and negotiate a studio monitor down from three hundred ten dollars to two sixty five.
master_scenes.caption: Step 2: Agent compares 3 quotes ($310 down to $265) and pauses at the human gate.

master_scenes.speaker: alex
master_scenes.text: Third, tune your wallet spend cap live, tap the yellow Approve button once, and fourth, inspect your signed mandate receipt.
master_scenes.caption: Step 3 & 4: Tune wallet caps live, tap Approve once, and inspect your receipt.

master_scenes.speaker: maya
master_scenes.text: Inside our Rust settlement lab, Vaulty guards every dollar. Any quote over your five hundred dollar single cap hits a laser gate and fails closed.
master_scenes.caption: Rust Vault Guardrail: quotes above your $500 single cap fail closed immediately.

master_scenes.speaker: alex
master_scenes.text: When you flip the orange human switch, Rust mints a SHA two fifty six mandate stamp, captures PayPal Orders v2, and blocks duplicate replays.
master_scenes.caption: Human switch mints a SHA-256 mandate, captures PayPal Orders v2, and blocks replays.

master_scenes.speaker: maya
master_scenes.text: Every preset ships live calculators right on screen: split dinner receipts with tip by PayPal QR, or bill Berlin in euros with four-part Pay Later.
master_scenes.caption: Live calculators: QR Dinner Receipt Split + EUR Pay Later & Creator Payouts.

master_scenes.speaker: alex
master_scenes.text: Hold duplicate subscriptions behind a dispute shield, pool neighborhood solar shares, and audit every cent in AG Grid.
master_scenes.caption: Dispute Shield, Neighborhood Solar Pool, and live AG Grid v36 reconciliation.

master_scenes.speaker: maya
master_scenes.text: Open tab four for our built-in asciicn studio: sixty four shadcn ASCII effects, rotating 3D globes, shaders, and live Web Audio soundtracks.
master_scenes.caption: Tab [04] asciicn Studio: 3D globes, shaders, text effects, and Web Audio score.

master_scenes.speaker: alex
master_scenes.text: Export frames to text, SVG, PNG, or WebM video, where one prompt teaches your coding agent.
master_scenes.caption: Export frames to .txt, .svg, .png, or .webm video. One prompt teaches your agent.

master_scenes.text: PayTable is live and open source today.
